posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: After Pete Crow-Armstrong broke HOFer Billy Williams’ 56-year Cubs record for HRs in season by LHH, he told PCA in phone convo after game he too would’ve been chanting M-V-P with the crowd. “Ain’t no telling what this kid is going to do,” Williams told Tribune www.chicagotribune.com/2026/09/19/c...
posts.jp: Pete Crow-Armstrongが左打者の シーズン本塁打でBilly Williamsの56年ぶり記録を更新。本人も「試合後に電話でそう言った。このガキが何をやるのか、見当も付かねえ」とWilliams氏。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Pete Alonso fires the Orioles into the lead with his second home run of the game. That's his 40th home run of the season, and it gives Baltimore a 4-3 lead over the Blue Jays in the eighth. Where would the Orioles be without that guy?
posts.jp: Pete Alonsoの2試合連発で、オリオールズが逆転リード。今季40号本塁打でブルージェイズ相手に8回4-3とリード。このチームにAlonsoがいなかったらどうなってた？

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: #BlueJays lose, 4-3. The arse... is out of 'er.

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: Brett Bateman is leaving the game with an injury. He walked off himself, slowly, and just got help going down the dugout steps with his arms over the shoulders of the #BlueJays trainer and John Schneider.
posts.jp: Brett Batemanが負傷で交代。自分で歩いて出たが、ダグアウト段を下りる時には#BlueJeysのトレーナーとSchneideerに肩を支えられた。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Today is Teddy Alonso’s first birthday. Pete Alonso acknowledged Teddy is too young to really know what happened tonight, but maybe in a few years, the two home runs from Pete will be a cool birthday moment to look back on
posts.jp: Teddy Alonsoは今日が1歳の誕生日。Pete Alonso本人も言ってるけど、数年したら今夜の2本の本塁打が素敵な思い出になるかな🥰

posts.text: Alex Bregman shared another update to his IG story this morning of how his face is looking after getting hit with the foul ball yesterday:
posts.jp: Alex Bergmanが昨日のファウルボールで被った顔の怪我の最新状況をIG ストーリーで投稿。
